fieldNotes.buildingId: Address 1250 Whitaker Rd geocoded onto an intersection inside a dense Plainfield logistics park (AllPoints area near Indianapolis airport). Neighbouring buildings carry other addresses (a FedEx building reads '1399 South Perry Rd'). The audited building is the long N-S grey-roofed warehouse on the W side of the pin whose office and check-in driveway front Whitaker Rd at the pin. Web research confirms Niagara Plainfield is 442,215 sq ft at 1250 Whitaker Rd. No on-building Niagara signage was readable in available panos, so building ID is medium-confidence.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The entrance driveway off Whitaker Rd has a controlled-entry setup: a small blue kiosk/booth structure beside the drive, a digital sign monument, a fence/gate across the lane, and traffic cones in the entry lane. truckGate = true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: The structure at the gate is small (roughly one parking-space footprint) - more consistent with an unmanned check-in kiosk / call-box than a multi-window staffed guard booth. Classed as remote check-in (remoteGs true, guardShack false), but the kiosk-vs-booth distinction is low-confidence from Street View.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep entry drive plus a large W-side dock apron give 3+ truck post-gate stacking room.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: A long dock face runs the W side of the building with many trailers backed in - estimated ~50-70 doors, band 50+. Exact count low-confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Marked trailer-parking stalls along the W edge beyond the dock apron hold ~35 trailers; capacity ~80, band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated on-site trailer storage rows on the W side of the building.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks are concentrated on one (W) building face; shipping and receiving are not on physically separate banks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance apron leaves room to add an express bypass lane alongside the kiosk.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Plainfield logistics park on the edge of the Indianapolis metro, bordered by open ground - classed Rural (edge-of-town industrial).
